_comment: Regression thresholds for check_regression.py. Keys under 'metrics' are
dotted paths into report['aggregate']; values are {'min': x} or {'max': x}.
These carry generous initial slack. Once 3+ real nightly runs establish
variance, tighten them toward the observed floor — procedure in
backend/evals/README.md. render_tester has no threshold: evals run with
RENDER_MODE=modal, so that gate is disabled by design.
'coverage' is the floor on papers actually evaluated: at least
papers_requested - max_papers_not_evaluated (never less than 1). A paper
that errors (arXiv 503, ingest crash) also counts as a failure in
viz_yield_rate: it owed max_viz visualizations and delivered none.
